# OncoBayes2

Bayesian logistic regression model with optional
EXchangeability-NonEXchangeability parameter modelling for flexible
borrowing from historical or concurrent data-sources. The safety model
can guide dose-escalation decisions for adaptive Oncology phase I
dose-escalation trials which involve an arbitrary number of drugs.

## Getting Started

To get a quick overview over the package functionality, please refer to
the introductory
[vignette](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/articles/introduction.html).
An additional vignette discusses the use of historical data via the
[meta-analytic-approach](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/articles/map_approach.html).

Global options and references

- [`OncoBayes2-package`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/OncoBayes2.md)

## Model fitting

- [`blrm_exnex()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/blrm_exnex.md)
  [`print(`*`<blrmfit>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/blrm_exnex.md)
  : Bayesian Logistic Regression Model for N-compounds with EXNEX
- [`blrm_trial()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/blrm_trial.md)
  [`print(`*`<blrm_trial>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/blrm_trial.md)
  : Dose-Escalation Trials guided by Bayesian Logistic Regression Model
- [`update(`*`<blrm_trial>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/update.blrm_trial.md)
  : Update data and/or prior of a BLRM trial
- [`update(`*`<blrmfit>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/update.blrmfit.md)
  : Update data of a BLRM analysis

## Model specification

- [`blrm_formula_linear()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/blrm_formula_linear.md)
  : Build a BLRM formula with linear interaction term in logit-space
- [`blrm_formula_saturating()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/blrm_formula_saturating.md)
  : Build a BLRM formula with saturating interaction term in logit-space

## Examples

- [`example-combo2`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/example-combo2.md)
  : Two-drug combination example
- [`example-combo2_trial`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/example-combo2_trial.md)
  : Two-drug combination example using BLRM Trial
- [`example-combo3`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/example-combo3.md)
  : Three-drug combination example
- [`example-single-agent`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/example-single-agent.md)
  : Single Agent Example
- [`example_model()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/example_model.md)
  : Runs example models

## Datasets

- [`hist_SA`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/hist_SA.md)
  : Single-agent example
- [`hist_combo2`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/hist_combo2.md)
  : Dataset: historical data on two single-agents to inform a
  combination study
- [`codata_combo2`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/codata_combo2.md)
  : Dataset: historical and concurrent data on a two-way combination
- [`hist_combo3`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/hist_combo3.md)
  : Dataset: historical and concurrent data on a three-way combination
- [`drug_info_combo2`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/drug_info_combo2.md)
  : Dataset: drug information for a dual-agent combination study
- [`dose_info_combo2`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/dose_info_combo2.md)
  : Dataset: trial dose information for a dual-agent combination study

## Misc

- [`bind_rows_0()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/bind_rows_0.md)
  : Bind rows of multiple data frames with zero fill
- [`nsamples(`*`<blrmfit>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/nsamples.blrmfit.md)
  : Return the number of posterior samples
- [`logit()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/lodds.md)
  [`inv_logit()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/OncoBayes2/reference/lodds.md)
  : Logit (log-odds) and inverse-logit function.
